title: LAraBench: Benchmarking Arabic AI with Large Language Models
benchmark_measurement: Machine translation performance on a religious text (the Bible) and the models' tendency to hallucinate content when translating it.
findings: During the machine translation task on the Bible dataset, GPT models (especially GPT-3.5-turbo) were found to hallucinate and insert additional content from their parametric memory into the translation.
